semantics.status: clear = readable canonical relationship; qualified = partial/conflicting evidence; unusable = no numeric relationship. None authorizes runtime quoting.
semantics.sides: items is supplied merchandise for asks/guide/completions and sought merchandise for bids; payments are alternative whole baskets, never allocated component prices.
semantics.constraints: Additional source assertions, not interchangeable payment alternatives. payment_conditions keys are zero-based payment alternative indices.
semantics.quantities: Rational valuation relationships, not fractional native inventory items. Null payments are unpriced; their items identify subjects only, not known transaction quantities.
semantics.identities: Selected XML Item names/IDs. Aliases are source-specific interpretations, not universal string lookup; video bindings apply only to curated records, never unresolved aliases.
semantics.independence: Same citation IDs share evidence; repeated ads and split records are not independent corroboration. No cross-source conversion, averaging, or market-constant claim.
semantics.safety: Historical amulet evidence does not authorize resurrection. Runtime tradability and safety restrictions require separate verification.
